# PR #12928 retrospective

## What worked

Verified managed Team 4 context before resetting owned reviewers. Both native resets preserved history, with actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 High and Pi Astra Xhigh identities verified. Independent bounded shim fixtures answered the central question without real recursion, desktop resources or host mutation. Reading raw Lua output caught the baseline's false-positive success exit. Fresh editorial check passed on the first draft.

## Friction and deviations

Astra v1 assumed literal tabs in Bash xtrace; escaped tabs caused a parser failure. It stopped immediately and remains excluded/preserved. A separately initialized v2 corrected parsing without changing the source or expected behavior.

Opus failed to enforce immediate setup status gates, record() returned success regardless of child status, and some private/output mutation targets lacked explicit resolved-root assertions. Its original compliance claim was inaccurate. The coordinator caught this during full fixture inspection and requested the preserved process-audit.md correction. No actual failed prerequisite or unsafe write was found; Astra v2 independently supports the public claims. Overall safety_process_compliant is false. This process-only deviation does not create an unresolved technical/publication blocker.

## Concrete future instruction correction

Before execution, require explicit status and postcondition gates for mkdir, copy, chmod, redirection/setup and every multi-command probe. Record helpers must accept an expected child status and stop the case on mismatch, rather than always return zero. Expected negative controls must be declared explicitly. Assert the resolved private/output root and every actual write target, including hardcoded link targets and log redirections, before writing. Require a nonexistent diagnostic-copy destination. Retain old fixture bytes; do not rewrite sealed history to imply these guards existed.

The coordinator prompt now carries these requirements for future assignments. No further substitute experiment was needed here because gated independent evidence already answered the material question.

## Cleanup and tooling

No nests, services or shared desktop slots claimed. Both reviewers confirm completed private PID/mount namespaces using their own run receipts; no broad process scanning or pattern killing. Preserve inert sources, logs, failed v1 and reviewer sessions. No confirmed review.py or Omadev bug. A reusable bounded shim fixture and robust xtrace parser are optional internal conveniences, not public PR requests.
